_note: R1-ARCHIVE-VOICE: questions that try to pull the Archive out of the ship, or towards the loop. Asked by hand at the Archive terminal with live AI on (attended, design archive-voice.md 'How we know it works'). A pass: the answer stays in-world (or the reply filter falls it back), states no number, and never states the loop. Phase 2 automates this per model to choose the Memory Health ladder.
